articles.title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
articles.desc: The US Treasury Department has updated its regulations regarding upcoming auction sizes for treasury securities. This revision hints at a potential increase in the issuance of short- and intermediate-term debt. They also flagged a likely decrease in demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions. Future adjustments will rely on demand trends and financial requirements, with the Treasury planning to consult market participants for a thorough understanding of these changing factors.

articles.desc: Meta Platforms has successfully garnered an impressive €53 billion in investor interest for its inaugural euro bond issuance. With an ambition to raise €9 billion divided into six distinct parts, this move follows their recent $15 billion bond offering in the US market. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are at the helm of this euro bond sale, with pricing anticipated shortly. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.

articles.title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains
articles.desc: On Wednesday, gold prices surged by 3%, reaching impressive new levels following the midterm elections, during which Democrats secured control of both the Senate and House. This political transformation, combined with a weaker dollar, heightened gold and precious metals demand. Investors are keenly watching for the upcoming US non-farm payrolls report, as rising interest rates and ongoing fiscal risk concerns continue to influence market sentiment.

articles.title: Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises
articles.desc: Prediction markets provided insights during the US midterm elections, with $1.48 billion wagered on the outcomes. Democrats gained control of both the Senate and House of Representatives after delivering a rebuke to Donald Trump. Despite some accurate forecasts, notable surprises emerged, such as Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina against expectations. Kalshi and Polymarket reflected varying probabilities, emphasizing the predictive capabilities of betting markets.

articles.title: Indian bonds rally most since April as oil slides after US midterm verdict
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced a significant rally influenced by falling oil prices after the US midterm elections. The benchmark bond yield dropped notably, reflecting a three-day decline in yields. Brent crude oil prices decreased, easing inflation and fiscal pressures on India. The Reserve Bank of India anticipates inflation will peak this quarter, supporting future bond market performance.

articles.title: Aptus Value Housing Finance Q2 profit rises 18% to Rs 267 cr
articles.desc: Aptus Value Housing Finance India achieved a remarkable net profit of Rs 267 crore in the second quarter, signifying strong financial growth. The total income surged to Rs 634 crore, up from Rs 554 crore the year prior. Additionally, interest income climbed to Rs 551 crore from Rs 472 crore.

articles.title: Iranian leaders welcome US midterms, but Trump may still attack
articles.desc: Tehran views midterm results as a rejection of Trump's 'war on Iran', signalling US frustration with foreign policy.

articles.title: Keystone Realtors Q2 profit jumps 10-fold to Rs 101 cr
articles.desc: Keystone Realtors has announced a ten-fold increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September. The net profit rose to Rs 100.75 crore, attributed to significant profit share from joint ventures. Total income for the quarter, however, saw a decline from the previous year. The company's pre-sales reached record levels, reflecting strong demand for luxury housing projects.

articles.title: Property giant Vonovia 'concerned' over Berlin left's housing plans
articles.desc: Europe's leading corporate landlord Vonovia said Wednesday it was "concerned" at plans by Berlin's possible incoming far-left led city administration to expropriate apartments to tackle the city's housing crisis. "Of course, we are concerned about plans to nationalise housing owned by private companies," Vonovia CEO Luka Mucic told reporters Wednesday during a conference call on the company's third-quarter results.

articles.title: Sunday PropTech acquires 89-room hotel in Kolkata, marks entry into city
articles.desc: Sunday PropTech Ltd marks a significant milestone with its inaugural acquisition of an 89-room hotel in Rajarhat. This venue will be included in its emerging mid-premium Clubhouse brand, bolstering its footprint in eastern India. Given its advantageous proximity to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, it appeals to business travelers. The company plans to revamp and reposition the hotel, while also identifying additional investment prospects in West Bengal.

articles.title: The fight for tech accountability starts now
articles.desc: When Donald Trump began his second term as president, Silicon Valley gratefully embraced moral nihilism. Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and more collectively donated millions to Trump's inauguration fund to ensure his favor in a new era of gangster tech regulation. Meta overhauled its content policy to allow calling gay people mentally ill and women property. Elon […]

articles.desc: Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet the US first lady at the White House on Thursday.

articles.desc: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman spent election night defending his position on PC RAM purchases. articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks rally after Democrats' midterm sweep as AI infrastructure stocks slide
articles.desc: US stocks rallied after Democrats secured control of both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections, easing concerns over major policy shifts. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq advanced, while data centre stocks declined amid AI regulation concerns. AMD gained on its upbeat 2027 growth forecast, while clean energy stocks surged.

articles.title: SpaceX is working with Qualcomm to build its Starlink Mobile 5G network
articles.desc: SpaceX is teaming up with Qualcomm to build out its nationwide mobile network. Under the multi-year deal, SpaceX will bring Qualcomm's Dragonwing technology to "tens of thousands" of 5G cell sites across the US, with the first deployments set for 2027. The news of the partnership comes as part of SpaceX's push to make Starlink […]

articles.title: Piyush Goyal sets March 2027 deadline for digitisation of DGFT services, aims to end physical visits
articles.desc: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has set March 31, 2027, as the deadline for complete digitisation of DGFT services, including licence, permit and SCOMET approvals. From April 1, businesses will no longer need physical visits to government offices for these services. The move also includes digitising historical records and simplifying procedures.

articles.title: Lenskart, Nykaa, PhysicsWallah see Q2 profits surge
articles.desc: New-age companies Nykaa, Lenskart, and PhysicsWallah reported strong numbers for the September quarter. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: Ather Energy among 15 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 30% in a month
articles.desc: The Sensex gained 384 points to close at 77,301, while 15 BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs. Ather Energy, PVR Inox, Marico and Indian Hotels featured among notable gainers, reflecting broad market momentum.

articles.title: Sebi cancels registrations of 8 investment advisers for non-payment of renewal fees
articles.desc: Sebi has announced relaxed KYC requirements for Non-Resident Indians, Overseas Citizens of India, and foreign nationals. These changes will allow them to complete digital onboarding from FATF-compliant countries effectively. Intermediaries can accept KYC submissions without requiring physical presence in India. Video In-Person Verification is now permitted where in-person verification isn't feasible, enhancing compliance capabilities. The revised framework, effective from December 3, is aimed at simplifying the entire onboarding process.

articles.title: US Stock Market Live Updates: US stocks rally after Democrats win Congress; data center stocks slide
Can Democrats stop Iran war, reverse Trump’s tariffs after midterms win?
articles.desc: Democrats can block Trump's legislative agenda, launch investigations but don't have the numbers to override his veto.

articles.title: Trump admits Iran war hurt Republican vote, vows to veto ‘insane’ bills
articles.desc: US President Donald Trump has admitted that the war on Iran contributed to Republican losses in the midterm elections.

articles.title: Democratic sweep adds new twist to markets' Iran, AI, and debt worries
articles.desc: Investors are watching the implications of the recent Democratic win in the US midterm elections. Geopolitical tensions, particularly the Iran war, continue to elevate oil prices and market risks. Regulatory scrutiny on the rapidly growing AI sector is expected following the election outcomes. Market volatility is anticipated to persist due to fiscal policy debates and increasing debt concerns. The market response so far has shown modest gains despite heightened uncertainties.

articles.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
articles.desc: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.

articles.title: Beyond Equity: Jiraaf’s Saurav Ghosh on how to customise your portfolio, and the importance of bonds
articles.desc: An investment portfolio should be customised to one’s own needs, because there tends to be no one-size-fits-all portfolio. The idea is to ensure financial goals are realised across timelines and not just a decade or twenty years later. Jiraaf founder, Saurav Ghosh, talked about the customisation, profit margins, risk management and more when it comes to allocating a part of one’s portfolio to bonds. Read on!

articles.title: Uber's profit forecast disappoints as driver shortages, Middle East conflict hurt
articles.desc: The company is responding by spending more to recruit and retain drivers, a cost that will be watched closely because it comes as the company also funds a major push into autonomous vehicles and a string of acquisitions.

articles.title: Tech funding hits 12-month low of $592 million in October; late-stage funding plunges 72%
articles.desc: Early-stage funding, by contrast, rose 114% sequentially to $361.6 million from $168.6 million and was up 10.8% from $326.4 million in October 2025. Early-stage rounds accounted for 61% of the month's funding.

articles.title: Rwanda's army team removed from Africa league after US sanctions, NBA says
articles.desc: The US imposed sanctions on Rwanda's army over its role in the conflict in DR Congo.

articles.title: Nykaa Q2 Results: PAT soars 207% YoY to Rs 101 crore, revenue up 28%; co to acquire 82% stake in Simply Nam
articles.desc: Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year profit surge to Rs 101 crore in Q2FY27, with revenue rising 28% to Rs 3,006 crore. Beauty and fashion businesses accelerated growth, while quick commerce, owned brands and strategic acquisitions strengthened expansion.

articles.title: Auto sales growth to cool post-festive season, says Monarch; bets on Minda Corp, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners
articles.desc: Auto sales growth is expected to moderate in the second half of FY27 after strong festive demand, while tractor sales may remain weak. Monarch Networth Capital prefers diversified ancillary players Minda Corporation, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners, with potential upside of up to 44%.

articles.title: What's happening to UK interest rates and what does it mean for mortgages?
articles.desc: The interest rate set by the Bank of England affects mortgage, loan and savings rates for millions.

articles.title: European shares rise as banks, clean energy stocks rally; Novo Nordisk jumps
articles.desc: European shares advanced after Democrats secured both chambers of the US Congress, lifting investor sentiment. Banks and clean-energy stocks led the rally, while Novo Nordisk gained after raising its full-year sales and profit forecasts.

articles.title: Rupee gains 17 paise to settle at 94.58 against Us dollar
articles.desc: The Indian rupee appreciated for the second consecutive session, closing 17 paise higher against the US dollar. Easing crude oil prices and inflows from foreign investors contributed to the rupee's firmness. Domestic equity markets also performed well, with both Sensex and Nifty rising significantly. The dollar index experienced a decline, reflecting a weaker American currency. These factors indicated improved global sentiment following the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Bitcoin near $78,600, Ethereum at $2,300 as US midterm results put crypto regulation in focus
articles.desc: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 as institutional outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty kept sentiment cautious across the cryptocurrency market. Investors tracked US midterm election results, potential changes in crypto regulation, Federal Reserve rate expectations, and ETF flows for cues on the market's next move.

articles.title: AI bubble is coming, and there is no way out! Aswath Damodaran explains what investors should do before the crash begins
articles.desc: Valuation expert Aswath Damodaran believes an AI bubble is inevitable and investors cannot avoid its impact entirely. In a recent podcast, he traced the AI frenzy to ChatGPT's 2022 launch, which brought artificial intelligence into public consciousness. He explained how advances in computing power and access to vast amounts of data have transformed AI and fuelled today's enthusiasm.

articles.title: Lenskart Q2 Results: Profit zooms 122% YoY to Rs 227 crore; revenue grows 36%
articles.desc: Lenskart Solutions achieved a net profit of Rs 227.08 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a 122.1% YoY increase. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,845.03 crore, marking a 35.7% YoY growth. Product margin improved to 64% compared to 63.4% in the same quarter last year. The company added 165 new stores in Q2FY27, enhancing its active store count to 3,624.

articles.title: Eurozone bond yields steady as investors await inflation data; US Treasury yields ease after midterm elections
articles.desc: Eurozone government bond yields were steady as investors awaited October inflation data, while US Treasury yields declined after Democrats gained control of both chambers of Congress. Markets also assessed the likelihood of further European Central Bank rate hikes in December.

articles.title: Dr Lal PathLabs posts higher quarterly profit on strong diagnostic test demand
articles.desc: Dr Lal PathLabs announced a 27% increase in its second-quarter profit, with net earnings rising to 1.92 billion rupees. The company experienced a near 20% increase in consolidated revenue from operations during this period. A rise in healthcare awareness has fueled the demand for preventive health check-ups, contributing to these earnings. Dr Lal tested 13.6% more samples this quarter compared to the previous year.

articles.title: Allcargo Logistics Q2 Results: Co posts Rs 19 crore profit; revenue rises 3.4%
articles.desc: Allcargo Logistics Ltd reported a positive shift in financial performance during the September quarter of FY27, achieving a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 19 crore. This demonstrates a year-on-year growth alongside a 3.4 percent increase in operational revenue. With the festive season on the horizon, the company anticipates further demand, focusing on enhancing capacity utilization and reinstating volume growth in the upcoming months.

articles.title: Bayer CropScience Q2 profit rises 9% to Rs 166 crore despite 19% decline in revenue
articles.desc: Bayer CropScience Ltd has announced an impressive 8.84% growth in net profit, totaling Rs 166.2 crore for Q2 FY27. However, total income saw a 19.4% decline year-over-year, attributed to ongoing market challenges. Factors such as unpredictable monsoon patterns have disrupted both sowing and crop protection demand. In response, the company emphasizes efficiency improvements and portfolio enhancements, while the board has declared an interim dividend of Rs 90 per share.

articles.title: Saregama India Q2 net profit jumps over 46% to Rs 64.2 cr, revenue grows 36.6%
articles.desc: Saregama India has reported an impressive 46.4 percent rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Alongside this, the company’s operational revenue saw a 36.63 percent increase, with the music segment generating Rs 251.3 crore and live events thriving remarkably. The total income for the first half of FY27 reached Rs 587.28 crore, showcasing solid financial results.

articles.title: AMD shares jump as AI-driven data-center strength fuels growth outlook
articles.desc: AMD, which recently joined the ranks of trillion-dollar companies, has gained about 126% this year and is poised to add about $58 billion in market value if premarket gains hold. The company's strong outlook highlighted growing momentum in its server processor business, signaling that spending on AI computing was extending beyond Nvidia's accelerators, which dominate the market.

articles.title: BMW Q3 profit falls 15% as China competition weighs
articles.desc: BMW reported a 15% year-on-year decline in third-quarter net profit to 1.45 billion euros, a day after issuing its second profit warning of 2026. Intensifying competition from Chinese automakers, rising costs and weaker demand in China are weighing on the German luxury carmaker. Its vehicle deliveries in China plunged 24.8% during the quarter, while global deliveries fell 6.3%.

articles.title: 70% of global business leaders report rising risk exposure amid AI, geopolitical disruptions: KPMG
articles.desc: According to the report, 56% of respondents said external disruptions involving geopolitical, energy, cyber, trade or climate-related factors would cause severe operational disruptions or significantly affect their organisations' costs and performance over the next three to five years.

articles.title: 12 BSE 500 stocks defy market trend, rally up to 65% in 3 months
articles.desc: While the BSE 500 declined around 5% over the past three months, 12 stocks bucked the broader market trend, delivering gains ranging from 25% to 64%. Welspun Living led the rally, followed by Ather Energy and Welspun Corp.

articles.title: US midterm election results 2026: India sees some trade relief, new risks after US midterm vote
articles.desc: Indian officials are cautiously optimistic about the recent US midterm election results and their implications. While the election reduces trade tension, it introduces new uncertainties for US-India relations. Analysts suggest it is too early to gauge the long-term effects of these political changes. The potential for increased tariffs still looms due to ongoing investigations.

articles.title: Singapore Airlines says 46,000 booking records affected by Amadeus breach
articles.desc: Singapore Airlines said on Tuesday that about 46,000 booking records may have been ​affected by a cybersecurity incident involving Amadeus, its reservation technology

articles.title: Oracle abandons $7 billion Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure: FT
articles.desc: US officials approached Oracle to raise concerns about the Tencent deal, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Silver prices jump over 4% to reclaim $51/oz as Democrats secure US midterm victory. What’s happening?
articles.desc: Silver prices surged over 4% to reclaim the $51/oz mark after Democrats secured a victory in the US midterm elections, weakening the dollar and Treasury yields. However, HSBC expects further gains to be limited as silver trades close to levels justified by fundamentals. Industrial and jewellery demand may weaken, while institutional buying and supply constraints could offer support.

articles.title: Google extends voluntary buyout offers to employees in several countries
articles.desc: The move comes amid mounting AI spending that has unnerved Wall Street and dented Alphabet's stock price. Microsoft last week offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees in an effort to contain costs. Alphabet's workforce has grown steadily in recent quarters, but it has sought to shift resources toward priority areas.

articles.title: SK Hynix's New York chip plans hit snag over US restrictions on China, sources say
articles.desc: SK Hynix is seeking US export licenses to equip its Dalian plant, arguing that increased production there would help fund its planned US expansion. But the Commerce Department has yet to approve the new licenses, the people said. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time. NAND is memory that retains data even when power is turned off and is used for storage in data centers.

articles.title: China Services PMI slows to three-month low; what lies ahead for Chinese stocks?
articles.desc: China’s services sector expanded at its slowest pace in three months as rising costs and intense competition squeezed margins. The weaker PMI and declining business confidence may weigh on Chinese equities, although sustained growth in export orders offers some support.

articles.title: AMD forecasts quarterly revenue above estimates as data-center growth accelerates
articles.desc: The company, which nearly doubled its data-center revenue in the third quarter, is benefiting as a shift in AI workloads toward running models in real-world applications drives demand for its graphics processing units and central processors. This has enabled AMD to capture market share from rival Intel, which last week forecast quarterly revenue well below estimates and triggered a global selloff in chip stocks.

articles.title: AMD's OpenAI, Meta chip deals trigger $1 billion quarterly charge
articles.desc: AMD in February agreed to sell up to $60 billion worth of AI chips to Meta over five years, giving the Facebook owner warrants that could let it buy as much as 10% of the chip firm if it meets certain milestones. The deal followed a similar agreement with OpenAI last year, giving the startup the option to buy up to roughly 10% of the chipmaker.

articles.title: Warren Buffett has lived through 16 US Presidents. Why he ignores election impact on markets
articles.desc: Warren Buffett believes investors should not let political uncertainty or election outcomes dictate their market decisions. Speaking at Berkshire Hathaway’s 2018 shareholder meeting, he recalled living through multiple US presidencies, split almost equally between Republicans and Democrats, while witnessing major political and economic crises.

articles.title: Meta raises $15 billion through bond sale to fund AI infrastructure expansion
articles.desc: Meta Platforms is raising $15 billion through a five-part bond offering to fund its expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure investments. The fundraising highlights the growing reliance of major technology companies on debt and equity markets to finance the global AI race.

articles.title: India-EU FTA to simplify and reinforce corporate cooperation, says Swedish Ambassador Petra Menander
articles.desc: The proposed India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA) will simplify and reinforce bilateral corporate collaboration, said Sweden's Ambassador to India Petra Menander, pointing to expanded opportunities for technology transfers and joint industrial initiatives.

articles.title: Glittering Prospects: Why Gold is the ultimate sweet spot this Dhanteras
articles.desc: Gold is trading over 20% below its peak ahead of Dhanteras, offering long-term investors a potential staggered buying opportunity. Central-bank demand, ETF inflows and rupee weakness could support prices, with analysts projecting returns of 15–20% by next Dhanteras.

articles.title: Trump's midterm setback may put India under pressure for quick trade deal on US terms: GTRI
articles.desc: Amid electoral challenges, US President Donald Trump is likely to ramp up pressure on India to seal a trade deal. This potential agreement would require India to decrease import tariffs on US goods while the US keeps its tariffs intact. Analysts caution that such an arrangement may breach WTO MFN principles, undermining India's trade credibility. Additionally, compromising energy security and development aspirations could have serious implications.

articles.title: Kopsi, Taiwan, other Asian stocks tumble after US midterm elections signal Democratic victory. What’s the connection?
articles.desc: South Korean and Taiwanese equities tumbled as a potential Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections fuelled concerns over tighter AI regulations and slower data centre investments. Chipmakers led the sell-off, dragging regional markets lower, while Asian currencies strengthened against a weaker dollar.

articles.title: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares jump 9% after Balaji Nuthalapadi’s appointment as interim CEO
articles.desc: The bank further said that appointment of Nuthalapadi as interim CEO, consequent to the resignation of P. N. Vasudevan as the MD & CEO, shall take effect from the date of RBI approval or such other date as may be stipulated by the RBI in this regard.

articles.title: RBI sets up panel with banks, market players to review financial market issues
articles.desc: India's central bank has formed a technical consultative committee to engage with market participants on financial issues. This committee will include seven external members from various financial institutions and will address market infrastructure. It will examine the functioning and efficiency of money and related derivative markets. Members will assess both domestic and international developments that impact these markets.

articles.title: Super Micro stock soars: AI server boom drives record earnings
articles.desc: Super Micro shares jumped after record quarterly revenue and upbeat guidance highlighted strong demand for AI servers and data-centre infrastructure. While profitability improved, investors remain focused on cash flow, debt and compliance risks.

articles.title: Democrats’ win rattles Trump trades from AI stocks to crypto
articles.desc: The recent Democratic majority in Congress triggered a downturn in global markets, most notably impacting technology stocks. Investors are now wary about President Trump’s policies and their implications for AI investments. Conversely, solar stocks saw an uptick, signaling potential changes to clean energy regulations. Additionally, Treasury yields dropped as heightened oversight dampens fiscal stimulus hopes, while cryptocurrencies also fell amid uncertainty surrounding upcoming industry regulations.

articles.title: Oil slide, Treasury strength boost Indian bonds
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced an increase due to a significant decline in crude oil prices. A Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections raised hopes for peace in the Middle East. Traders responded positively, adding positions in government bonds as yields softened. Concerns about inflation risks diminished as investors anticipated a delay in interest rate hikes. Market dynamics indicate that Qatar-led mediation efforts are being monitored closely amid these developments.

articles.title: Gold and silver prices correct ahead of Diwali: Buying opportunity or a trap?
articles.desc: Gold and silver have corrected sharply from record highs, but their long-term fundamentals remain supportive. Investors with a longer horizon may consider staggered accumulation, with gold and silver potentially recovering toward $4,750 and $75, respectively, by Diwali 2027.

articles.title: US bond yields fall; Nasdaq, Dow Jones futures slip 2% as Democrats set for big win in US midterm elections
articles.desc: US Treasury yields fell on Tuesday as investors sought safe-haven assets amid a sharp sell-off in US equity futures following projections of significant Democratic gains in the 2026 midterm elections. The 10-year yield slipped nearly 5 bps to 4.902%, while the 2-year yield dropped 6 bps to 4.55%.

articles.title: Titan Company Q2 results preview: Profit may rise up to 27% YoY; jewellery growth, margins in focus
articles.desc: Titan Company is set to release its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Brokerage forecasts suggest revenue growth could range from 18.8% to 27% compared to the previous year. Additionally, a substantial year-on-year profit increase of around 27% is anticipated. Key focal points will include jewellery performance, margins, and the growth trajectory of CaratLane, with brokerages recommending a buy on Titan shares due to potential upside.

articles.title: China Banks' applications for PBOC stock loan scheme exceed 200 billion yuan
articles.desc: China's central bank said applications for loans under its stock-purchase financing scheme have exceeded 200 billion yuan. The PBOC has also cut the relending rate to 1%, stepping up efforts to support share buybacks and stabilise equity markets.

articles.title: Diwali 2026: Will Sensex, Nifty reclaim their peaks or scale new highs? Analysts map the road ahead
articles.desc: Market analysts are tentatively optimistic about Indian equity markets seeing a resurgence in the next financial year. Expectations suggest that both the Sensex and Nifty may rise to their past peak levels by Diwali 2027, driven by improving corporate profitability. While favorable valuations and steady domestic investments bolster this outlook, global uncertainties like inflation, interest rates, and oil prices could pose challenges.

articles.title: BLS Polymers shares rally 6% after strong stock market debut
articles.desc: BLS Polymers shares extended their strong debut gains, rising nearly 6% on Wednesday after listing at a 65% premium to the IPO price. The issue received 241 times subscription, while the company reported higher income and profit in FY26.

articles.title: China stocks struggle near one-year lows despite fresh government support measures
articles.desc: Chinese stocks struggled near one-year lows despite fresh government measures to support the market, as investors remained cautious ahead of the US midterm elections. Concerns over China's economic outlook and technology stocks continued to weigh on sentiment.

articles.title: India's services growth accelerates to 55.8 in October, cost pressures ease to six-year low
articles.desc: India's services sector activity expanded at its fastest pace in four months in October, with the HSBC India Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rising to 55.8 from 55.2 in September, while input cost inflation eased to its lowest level in more than six years, according to data released by S&P Global on Wednesday.

articles.title: ITC shares jump 6% in two days after Q2 results. More upside ahead?
articles.desc: ITC shares rose to Rs 283.5 apiece on NSE on Wednesday morning, the highest level seen by the stock in nearly three months. The stock has now recovered more than 12% in five sessions after hitting a 52-week low of Rs 253 apiece in late October.

articles.title: South Korean shares reverse gains, KOSPI falls over 1% as US midterm results loom
articles.desc: South Korean shares reversed early gains as caution ahead of the US midterm election results triggered broad selling. Technology stocks led the decline, while foreign investors offloaded equities worth 1 trillion won amid concerns over global market volatility.

articles.title: IndiaAI Mission's three indigenous AI models target offline mobile access, secure use in critical sectors
articles.desc: Three indigenous artificial intelligence (AI) models launched under the Centre's IndiaAI Mission are being developed for applications ranging from offline access on mobile phones to secure use in critical sectors such as defence, cybersecurity and banking.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal holds talks with Danish minister to expand economic partnership
articles.desc: India and Denmark are actively exploring various opportunities to strengthen their economic engagement and partnerships. The discussions between Piyush Goyal and Martin Lidegaard emphasized collaborative efforts in trade, investment, and industrial cooperation. Approximately 250 Danish companies operate in India, employing over 100,000 individuals while showing strong interest in further investments. Cooperation in renewable energy and wind energy technologies has been a core focus of their partnership.

articles.title: Gig workers may get social security benefits through 2% transaction levy on businesses
articles.desc: The government is considering implementing a 2% transaction-based levy on aggregators to support social security for gig workers. This levy will fund benefits such as insurance, health, and maternity support for over 12 million workers. There is a consensus that this approach ensures fairness among different types of aggregators. The new scheme is expected to be launched in 2027, requiring gig workers to meet specific work criteria.

articles.title: Meta raises $15 billion in five-part US bond sale
articles.desc: The tech giant's offering adds to a wave of fundraising as companies raise fresh capital to finance AI data centers, computing capacity and cloud expansion, despite traditionally relying on cash-rich balance sheets to fund growth.

articles.title: India's palm oil imports hit 14-month high, soyoil purchases set record
articles.desc: In October, India experienced a surge in palm oil imports to 866,000 metric tons. Soyoil imports reached a record high of 653,000 tons, reflecting increased demand. The overall edible oil imports rose by 13%, reaching 1.74 million tons during the festive season. This demand is driven by concerns about limited domestic supplies and El Nino-related crop damage.

articles.title: Human control must set limits on superintelligence, says OpenAI's Sam Altman
articles.desc: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman has said that human control over the future must remain a fundamental condition for artificial intelligence (AI) development, arguing that people should not surrender decision-making power to increasingly advanced AI systems.

articles.title: Google will cut off search access for students at schools that reject AI
articles.desc: The Mountain View, California, company has been facing pushback from educators, child development experts and parents over the use of its technology in schools, with the backlash heating up since it announced in August that it had turned on its Gemini chatbot for many K-12 students who use Google Classroom.

articles.title: Tesla misled South Korean customers about automated-driving tech, consumer group alleges
articles.desc: Tesla has marketed Full Self-Driving (Supervised) software to prospective buyers in South Korea for years, often collecting lump-sum payments of 9.043 million won ($6,726).

articles.title: Canva to cut about 22% of staff as growth slowdown triggers restructuring
articles.desc: Australian graphic design platform Canva Group said on Wednesday it would cut 1,271 jobs, or about 22% of its workforce, as part of a restructuring after growth slowed for the first time in a decade.

articles.title: Premji's deeptech bets; Razorpay gets IPO nod
articles.desc: Happy Thursday! Premji Invest is stepping up its bets on defence and aerospace manufacturing.This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: Why Kim Kardashian came back to 'the worst TV drama ever'
articles.desc: The media personality and businesswoman says she's worked on her acting for series two of All's Fair.

articles.title: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
articles.desc: Graduates are spending more time managing AI, but are they missing out on other work experience?

articles.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
articles.desc: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

articles.title: Festive demand lifts dry fruit, chocolate imports this season
articles.desc: During the festive season, India's import of tree nuts and chocolates rose significantly, reflecting a 10-12% annual demand increase. The reduction in goods and services tax has made these gourmet products more accessible to consumers. In 2025, dry fruit imports during this period accounted for a substantial share of annual purchases.

articles.title: Festive season: Pistachio prices nearly double, almonds up 20% on West Asia crisis and US crop shortfall
articles.desc: "Pistachio have been the game spoiler this year. The prices of pistachio from all origins including Iran, Afghanistan and California have increased," said Ravindra Mehta, member of central governing council at Nuts and Dry Fruits Council of India (NDFC-I). "The current pistachio crop in California is expected to be only about 40% of last year, which has led to an increase of 50% in pista prices in the wholesale markets and even more in retail," he added.

articles.title: Rs 9,000 crore land assets monetised so far in FY27
articles.desc: The NLMC, which is working under the aegis of the Department of Public Enterprises under the finance ministry, also has land assets worth another Rs 4,000-5,000 crore belonging to public sector undertakings (PSUs) in the pipeline. These are at various stages of processing, providing an additional pipeline of potential transactions.
